name: 3-root-2 Subdivision
definition: A hierarchical volume representation scheme where each subdivision step doubles the number of vertices, theoretically increasing vertex count by a factor of √2 in each dimension, compared to octree refinement which multiplies by 8.
summary: 3-root-2 subdivision is a hierarchical volume representation that refines meshes by doubling vertices per step, offering finer granularity than octree refinement through a specific geometric insertion sequence and B-spline wavelet updates.
